notes.title: "Divine Birds" update coming to Steam April 3rd! Limited time sale continues!
notes.notes:
Proud to announce the "Divine Birds" update is coming to Steam on April 3rd!

This means users will be able to enjoy all the content in Perfect Hand of Nostalpix on both Steam and the Nintendo Switch.

Here is the Steam trailer of the new update!

[previewyoutube=s9ZHlaMYyTo;full][/previewyoutube]

We will be announcing more details on the update soon!

Pick up the game now while the discount is still going!

And... We have partnered up with Isle of Swaps to provide a new bundle for Perfect Hand of Nostalpix! You can see the new bundle on the Perfect Hand of Nostalpix Steam page. The discount also applies to the bundle, so get it while it's hot!
